kamus.Marga Mulya berawal dari permukiman tran: Marga Mulya began as a transmigration settlement. On 19 January 1983, the first group of transmigrants from Central Java (Wonogiri, Boyolali, Grobogan) and East Java (Banyuwangi) was settled at a site then called Semangga 1 B Village. A second group arrived in 1984, followed by 40 households in 1985. Their settlement is still known today as Lokasi 40.
kamus.Rombongan transmigran pertama dari Jawa: The first transmigrants from Central and East Java arrived in Semangga 1 B Village.
kamus.Tahun 1985, desa yang sudah dihuni 350 k: In 1985, the village, by then home to 350 households, was released from KUPT (transmigration unit) supervision and held its first village head election. From then on it was named Marga Mulya Village, still within Merauke Subdistrict, with Lasiman as village head until 1988.
kamus.Di masa Kepala Desa Suyoto (1988–1998),: Under Village Head Suyoto (1988–1998), farming grew alongside the KUD Usaha Tama cooperative led by the late Sudiono. The third election in 1998 chose Poniman Sabariyanto (1998–2006). During this period the term “desa” was replaced by “kampung”, farming and livestock advanced, and roadside stalls along the main road, known as Warung Jagung, began to appear.
kamus.Kepala kampung keempat, Eva Hardianto (t: The fourth village head, Eva Hardianto (elected 2007), resigned in 2011. The government was then continued by Village Secretary Sunaryo as Acting Village Head under a decree of the Head of Semangga District. Development at that time relied heavily on residents' own efforts, until development funds from the Regency Government grew larger. The village also prepared for division with twin facilities: 2 village offices/halls, 2 sub-health centres, 2 primary schools, 2 early-childhood centres, 1 kindergarten, and 2 sports fields.
kamus.Muntamah, perwakilan perempuan, terpilih: Muntamah, a women's representative, was elected as the fifth village head for 2012–2018. Simultaneous elections on 11 September 2018 chose Zubaidah Alfakir for 2019–2024, who adopted the Marga Mulya RPJMK 2019–2024. The village government is currently led by Acting Village Head Sunaryo, S.AP.

kamus.Kajian sumber daya dalam RPJMK menempatk: The resource assessment in the RPJMK positions Marga Mulya as a rice production centre. Its soil is best suited to paddy fields, and almost every family depends on farming for income.
kamus.Sawah, kini seluas 1.758,19 ha (RPJMK 20: Rice fields, now covering 1,758.19 ha (the 2019 RPJMK recorded 1,116 ha), are the mainstay, plus 183 ha of secondary-crop land and 118 ha of land already cleared and planned as rice fields. There are also 282 ha of settlement, 46 ha of swamp, and 2 km of river.
kamus.586 keluarga hidup dari pertanian dan pe: 586 families make a living from farming and plantations; others from trade, transport, processing industries, and services. Farmers plant rice twice a year (wet season and dry season), and 1 ha of paddy yields about 4 tonnes of unhusked rice.
kamus.Kampung memiliki 38 km jalan kampung, 41: The village has 38 km of village roads, 41 km of farm roads, 24 bridges, 49 km of drainage, and 5 bendali (water retention ponds). Residents' farm equipment includes 42 hand tractors, 4 tractors, and 3 rice threshers, operated by 18 farmer groups.
kamus.Gotong royong dan kegiatan keagamaan men: Mutual cooperation and religious activities bind residents together: 18 yasinan prayer groups (one in each RT), a village-wide Jumat Pahing religious gathering with 350–450 attendees, 6 majelis taklim/rebana groups, 3 Qur'an schools with 227 students, Sunday school, and kuda lumping arts groups.
